en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Abī Yaḥyā Al-Wāsiťi, from Abil Ḥasan Al-Ḥadhā, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: There is a graveyard close to you which is called Burāthā. One hundred and twenty thousand martyrs like the martyrs of Badr will be resurrected from this graveyard.
